description: Opaque value objects for PHP (gplanchat/opaque): secrets that do not leak through var_dump, print_r, var_export, serialize, string casts or reflection-based normalizers, libsodium ciphering with key rotation, and a Symfony Serializer bridge.
rules: The package is gplanchat/opaque and its namespace is Gplanchat\Opaque. Declare a secret by extending Gplanchat\Opaque\Opaque and build it with ::fromString().
Read a secret back only with the function Gplanchat\Opaque\disclose(); there is no getter.
To store a secret, cipher it through a Gplanchat\Opaque\Keyring and store Ciphered::toWire(); serialize() on an Opaque throws LeakRefused.
With Symfony Serializer, register Gplanchat\Opaque\Bridge\Serializer\OpaqueNormalizer before ObjectNormalizer.
